.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/task/tests/**/judge.toml and prompt.md (parsed for criterion ids, quoted probe literals and word n-gram overlap)
evidence: Static row; no runtime measurement is required for it. (1) The skill's grep from quality-checks.md:26, widened by me with grader|grading|verifier|oracle|likert|gate|functional|polish|visual|scor|checker|evaluat|mcp|openrouter|test.sh|app_context|CHANGE_ME|TODO, returns zero matches across task/instruction.md, all six task/environment/instructions/*.md, seed_data.json and the agent Dockerfile. (2) None of the 52 cw_* criterion ids parsed from the five judge.toml files appears in the public files. (3) Of 82 quoted/backticked literals in tests/ only the ordinary word 'saved' also occurs publicly; no probe-style sentinel is named in brief, notes or seed (seed_data.json has an empty snippets array and a one-line note). (4) Longest shared word sequence between any public file and any tests/ judge.toml or prompt.md is under 8 words (zero 8-grams), so there is no long verbatim criterion overlap. (5) Paths named publicly are product/runtime paths only: /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json, /app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /api/health (instruction.md:3,5; integration.md:3,7,9); no /tests, /logs/verifier or score.py. (6) No weights, dimension names or model names. Closest wording is policy.md:5 ('Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract. The examples are ways to explain it, not exact selectors, CSS classes or implementation requirements'), which reads as client latitude and names no grader artefact; numeric values such as the five-second budget (behaviour.md:5) and 390 px (ui.md:17) are product requirements, not grader sentinels. Counterexample search: a weak app cannot gain from the brief because no probe value, criterion id or test path is disclosed; a conforming alternative is not disadvantaged by this row. raw-evidence-index.json artifact hashes all recompute correctly, but that index is scripted-golden evidence and is not relied on for this row. I did not independently recompute the input SHA256 (derivation not inspected); it is preserved as assigned.
